delete_file.description: Delete the data row from the incremental preprocessing database and move the physical file to quarantine.

keep.description: Keep the current incremental preprocessing record and do not generate SQL/BAT changes.

update_metadata.description: Update books/data metadata in the incremental preprocessing database without moving physical files.

insert_book.description: Insert a new books row and its data rows into the full library.

insert_data.description: Insert a new data row under an existing full-library book.

insert.description: Insert metadata rows that exist only in the incremental library.

fill_missing_metadata.description: Only fill metadata fields or links missing in the full library.

merge_metadata.description: Merge metadata records with the same business key but different non-ID fields.

relink_metadata.description: Map incremental metadata IDs to existing full-library metadata IDs.

keep_target.description: Keep existing full-library records and do not write incremental values.

report_only.description: Report the comparison result without changing the full library.
